value.answer: Hi, I'm sorry you're going through this, and I'm glad you reached out. To point you to the right fit, what's bringing you to therapy, and do you want in-person or online? If you're in Toronto and need it free, Ontario Structured Psychotherapy covers CBT for depression and anxiety. You don't need a health card or family doctor, and you can self-refer through ontariohealth.ca/osp. Low-cost options include Radcliffe Psychotherapy Clinic (5 free sessions with students, then $50 plus HST) and Get Reconnected (student interns at $45). Prices shift, so check before booking. If you're in crisis or feel unsafe, please call or text 988, or go to the nearest emergency room.
